    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
                      (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
                      (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if np.any(np.isnan(arr)) or np.any(np.isinf(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive log probabilities")
    # Check shapes match
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon) or \
       logp_no_call.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    # Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted future-token loss (negative weighted log prob)
    L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)
    L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm_weights)
    L_empty = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)

    # Use the stronger counterfactual baseline (min of no-call and call-only)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)

    # Margin and threshold
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
